title: Strong Cosmic Censorship at Weak Regularity
exact_target: For generic perturbations of Kerr initial data whose maximal globally hyperbolic developments have continuously extendible Cauchy horizons, are those developments nevertheless inextendible by Lorentzian metrics of regularity $C^0\cap W_{\mathrm{loc}}^{1,2}$? More generally, for generic asymptotically flat vacuum initial data, is the maximal globally hyperbolic development inextendible as a weak solution of the Einstein vacuum equations?
